   **Pricing and paywall.**

      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Jul 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Nancy Richey_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "I cannot cancel this app in the trial period. The directions don't line up with the experience. If you are not positive you want this app, do NOT start the trial period."
            2. _Deanajk_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "I don’t even know where to start all I know is I don’t understand why you would change something that wasn’t broken! I’ve been a premium user for 15 years!? There are so many things wrong with the new layout/UI/update, and I don’t have time to list all of them here. But if you’ve been a user for a while, then you already know. Please please please bring back some of the old features that you omitted with the update! I never thought I’d have to say that I’m considering other ways to track my macros for the first time in many many years. It’s a sad day for me! 😭"
            3. _Southern Roots_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "What’s going on? I paid for premium content for a year. But now the app is not letting me have access to the premium content that I paid for. I am totally locked out. No way to “restore purchases” just an error on their end. This is so bad devs. Please do better."
